name: Hair perfume / hair mist

lead: Hair perfume is a light spray designed for hair rather than skin, used to leave a pleasant scent trail when you move.

Fragrance is deposited on hair, which is said to hold and release scent. Perfume references classify light mists as low-concentration products (eau fraiche, 3% or less aromatic compounds). No hair-specific studies were found.

paras: People spray it lightly over dry or styled hair, often as a lighter alternative to or an extra layer on top of skin fragrance.
Fragrance ingredients can be allergenic; no hair-specific studies were found.

angle.text: Users spray hair mist as a lighter alternative to perfume on skin, leaving a scent in the hair that carries as they move. Grooming communities describe it as a way to add a scent trail.

lead: Hair perfume or hair mist is a light fragrance spray made for the hair, as an alternative to applying perfume to skin. It is used to leave scent in the hair and is discussed in grooming communities as a way to add a scent trail.

Perfume references classify light 'mists' and splashes as low-concentration products (eau fraiche, 3% or less aromatic compounds),[1] and general references note that perfume materials can include allergenic compounds.[1] No studies of hair-specific fragrances were found, and the perfume reference consulted does not address hair products.

paras: Hair mists are marketed as lighter and gentler than skin perfume, a claim made by sellers; traditional perfume application targets warm pulse points to release the scent.[1]

lore.intro: Hair mists are discussed as a subtle scent layer.

claims.claim: Hair mist leaves a scent trail that lasts
